objective: Compare four networks that pay independent machines to do AI work: Bittensor, Olas (Autonolas), Gensyn and the IMD swarm (identity.md NFT seats running the worker daemon; sources: github.com/Identity-md/worker, api.imd.fun, explorer.imd.fun).
